restoration_note: This teaching describes the self articulated as a five-formed body corresponding to the Five Worlds of Darkness — head=lion (fire), wings/back=eagle (wind), hands/feet=demons (smoke), belly=dragon (darkness), loins=fish (water). The formulaic structure 'another time when he wishes, he X' governs the transitions, allowing many small gaps to be filled by parallel. Three further triads structure the rest: beasts/myriads/hardness, then fire/cold/searching-of-hearts. Most lacunae are confidently restored from internal parallels and editor proposals. Larger lacunae in the central tripartite enumeration (gaps 38-40, 66) and the verb in §1638 (gap 24) lack sufficient internal constraint and are marked unrestorable or low confidence.
